headline: Smoke reported pouring from the upper floors of the World Trade Center North Tower.
A small private plane appears to have crashed into the World Trade Center in lower Manhattan.
First responders on the scene. Eyewitnesses describe a twin-engine commuter plane losing control.
Dow Jones pre-market futures slip 40 points on reports of explosion and fire at New York financial center.
A second large commercial aircraft has struck the South Tower of the World Trade Center.
FAA halts all departures heading to or through New York airspace. Possible coordinated hijackings.
NYSE and Nasdaq delay opening bell indefinitely as financial district evacuation begins.
